name: Jazz ii-V-I
pattern:
setcpm(120/4)
stack(
  s("~ ~ rd ~ ~ rd ~ rd").gain(0.4),
  s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").gain(0.3),
  note("f2 ~ bb2 ~ eb2 ~ ~ ~").s("sine").gain(0.7),
  note("<Fm7 Bb7 Ebmaj7 Ebmaj7>").s("triangle").struct("1 ~ ~ ~").release(0.8).gain(0.35)
)
progression: Fm7 - Bb7 - Ebmaj7 (ii - V - I in Eb)
description: A ii-V-I, the most common progression in jazz. Ride-led pulse with a light backbeat instead of four-on-the-floor; the walking bass outlines the chord roots.

source.note: No licensed source exists for this genre — Strudel's drum corpus has no techno, trap, ambient or jazz entries, and the community collections are unlicensed. Written by hand; the harmony is stated explicitly in `key` and `progression` so it can be checked against music theory rather than against this project's own analyzer.
